nodes.why_it_matters: Provide a verified running electrical network for the factory.
Continuously supply iron from natural resources to the production chain.
Continuously supply copper from natural resources to the production chain.
Provide powered compatible assembly machines after their technology is researched.
Continuously provide the science recipe’s intermediates, with recipes and transport validated before construction.
Connect the production chains and demonstrate the requested rate over a valid one-minute window.

steps.description: Place the held burner drill over iron ore and observe its output position.

execution_guidance.approach: Find a legal iron-covering candidate for the held burner drill, place it, and observe its actual output.
execution_guidance.rationale: The held drill avoids new crafting costs and can produce 15 ore per minute while other work proceeds.
constraints: Validate live resource coverage and placement.
Do not remove player-built structures.

steps.description: Place the held stone furnace to receive the drill’s output.

execution_guidance.approach: Use the observed drill output position to select a placement for the held furnace; check the actual output route afterward.
execution_guidance.rationale: Direct feeding avoids repeated hand mining and supply; the held furnace has a nominal capacity of 18.75 plates per minute.
constraints: Use fresh output geometry and a legal placement candidate.
Verify the drill feeds the furnace before relying on it.

steps.description: Fuel the iron cell and produce the plates required to unlock steam power.

execution_guidance.approach: Acquire fuel, supply the exact drill and furnace, and verify steam-power research after producing the trigger quantity.
execution_guidance.rationale: Fifty plates justify the setup: direct feeding can proceed unattended, while hand mining alone would take about 100 seconds plus repeated furnace supply.
constraints: Fuel both machines separately.
Verify production and the research trigger; do not treat held plates as newly produced.

steps.description: Gather 5 stone for a separate copper furnace, preserving the iron cell.

execution_guidance.approach: Acquire five stone from a native resource or finite source.
execution_guidance.rationale: A separate furnace costs five stone and avoids interrupting the direct-fed iron cell.
constraints: Keep the iron drill, furnace, and route intact.

steps.description: Craft one stone furnace from the 5 stone.

execution_guidance.approach: Hand-craft one stone furnace once five stone is held.
execution_guidance.rationale: The enabled recipe takes five stone and 0.5 seconds.
constraints: Verify the furnace in inventory.

steps.description: Gather 10 copper ore and at least 1 coal for copper smelting.

execution_guidance.approach: Hand-mine ten copper ore and obtain at least one coal.
execution_guidance.rationale: For ten plates, manual mining avoids the cost and placement of a separate drill; copper was observed locally.
constraints: Retain the ore and coal for the furnace.

steps.description: Place the new stone furnace without disturbing the iron cell.

execution_guidance.approach: Place the furnace at a legal reachable location and observe its exact identity.
execution_guidance.rationale: A separate furnace preserves the iron route; exact supply requires a fresh identity.
constraints: Do not alter the iron cell.

steps.description: Fuel the new furnace, smelt 10 copper ore, and verify electronics is unlocked.

execution_guidance.approach: Supply the new furnace with ten copper ore and coal and verify the electronics trigger.
execution_guidance.rationale: The live trigger requires ten copper plates; this short manual bootstrap avoids another drill setup.
constraints: Use the fresh exact furnace identity.
Verify research completion.

steps.description: Gather 10 coal as startup fuel for the automated fuel supply.

execution_guidance.approach: Gather 10 coal from a natural coal resource.
execution_guidance.rationale: The fresh inventory has no coal; a small hand-mined seed supply supports the later fuel infrastructure without assuming its geometry.
constraints: Do not disturb existing factory structures.
Verify the coal is in inventory.

steps.description: Gather 5 stone for a burner-miner furnace component.

execution_guidance.approach: Gather five stone from a natural resource patch.
execution_guidance.rationale: Hand mining five stone takes about 10 seconds before travel; a dedicated stone miner would cost more setup for this small bootstrap.
constraints: Avoid disturbing existing structures.

steps.description: Collect at least 9 iron plates in total for the miner and its gears.

execution_guidance.approach: Retrieve one iron plate from the observed iron furnace, after fresh exact-identity verification.
execution_guidance.rationale: Eight plates are held; the drill and its three gears require nine total. The furnace recently held 66.
constraints: Do not dismantle the furnace.
Recheck inventory and furnace identity.

steps.description: Craft one burner mining drill for the coal supply.

execution_guidance.approach: Craft three gears, one stone furnace, and one burner mining drill using the verified ingredients.
execution_guidance.rationale: The 5 stone and 9 plates cover the drill and intermediate recipes; the 10 coal is reserved for startup.
constraints: Verify the held drill before placement.
Resolve any changed inventory first.

steps.description: Install one burner mining drill on the nearby coal patch, preserving the existing iron cell.

execution_guidance.approach: Approach the coal patch, validate a resource-covering candidate, and place the held drill.
execution_guidance.rationale: The held drill needs no additional crafting; nominal coal output is 15/min and fuel use 2.25/min, provided fuel and output are available.
constraints: Preserve the existing iron cell.
Placement alone does not prove fuel delivery.

steps.description: Obtain two wood and craft one wooden chest while preserving the existing iron cell and coal drill.

execution_guidance.approach: Harvest the missing two wood and craft one wooden chest; verify its inventory count.
execution_guidance.rationale: A wooden chest costs two wood, avoiding eight iron plates and a trip to the iron furnace. It buffers the existing coal drill output.
constraints: Preserve the existing iron cell and coal drill.
Use actual inventory gains for wood.

steps.description: Install one wooden chest at the coal drill output and fuel the drill until it is working, preserving the existing iron cell.

execution_guidance.approach: Refresh the output-covering chest candidate, install the chest, then fuel the exact coal drill and verify it works.
execution_guidance.rationale: The observed output-covering site can accept a chest; 10 held coal is sufficient to bootstrap mining. Self-fueling and downstream delivery remain separate work.
constraints: Revalidate placement and drill identity.
Do not claim sustained fuel delivery from a buffer.
